decisions.reason: This navigation and observation camera remains tightly aligned with the firm's proven optical flight heritage and should stay attractive for ongoing spacecraft and Earth observation programs.
The modular camera line is very close to the core business, offers mission-specific configurability, and as a multi-model family is strategically efficient to retain.
The space situational awareness sensor suite extends the firm's established sensing capabilities into a growing mission need and fits its R&D-driven profile well.
The miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR sensor supports the firm's move toward compact advanced sensors, though its lower market prominence still suggests a somewhat less mature commercial position.
The radiation-hard space camera line fits the firm's reliability-focused space electronics and optics portfolio very well and its dedicated presentation suggests meaningful commercial commitment.

The asteroid navigation and imaging camera is technologically consistent with the firm's heritage, but its narrower application focus and lower website prominence make it the most exposed to reprioritization.
